false_negative_audit.order: drain Txpool lane, then every peer lane, then judge
false_negative_audit.time_rule: ObservedOnPeerLane iff earliest valid peer T_ingress <= TXPOOL_ACCEPTED.timestamp_ns (equality observed); later peer observations are FalseNegative with earliest_peer_ingress_ns recorded
false_negative_audit.comparability: EARLY_TX_SEEN: clock_id 1, source eth-broadcast/eth-pooled, aux[8..32] zero, 0 < T_packet_decoded <= T_ingress; TXPOOL_ACCEPTED: clock_id 1, source txpool, zero peer, zero aux; otherwise counted invalid

qualification.point: quiescent: Txpool lane sealed (shutdown set; geth ShutdownIngressV2 after txBroadcastLoop stopped, Rust ArenaV2::begin_shutdown), final producer counters read after the last producer call and before the qualification, audit polled until the lane is drained
qualification.interop_note: geth interop phase 1 leaves the arena unsealed because phase 2 rebinds a peer lane; its qualification is FalseNegatives(2), which precedes the window check

false_negative_audit.sealed_lane_end: V2Error::Shutdown at read == write ends a poll normally; LaneQuarantined and all other consumer errors count as consumer_errors
